settings.title: Colours
settings.text: Every colour of a Corvo rug can be changed. Choose from the [palette_count] colours of the Open Palette at no extra cost, or have any colour matched to your reference for [colour_price] per colour.
settings.image_alt: A technician measuring red dye in the colour laboratory

settings.title: The Open Palette
settings.text:
[palette_count] colours kept ready for any rug. Changing a colour of a design to one of them costs nothing extra.

On the page of a rug, open the colour step and choose a colour by its code.
settings.image_alt: A designer drawing a rug on a tablet, with yarn poms of the palette on the desk
settings.pending_text: Preview note: the swatches take their colours once the colour list is loaded. Until then the palette shows the codes only.

settings.title: Infinite Colours
settings.text: Any colour, matched to your reference, for [colour_price] per colour.

settings.title: Send your reference
settings.text: On the page of a rug, choose "Another colour" for any colour of the design, and type a reference or a description.
settings.image_alt: A designer choosing the colours of a rug on a tablet

settings.title: We match it
settings.text: The dye lab matches the colour and dyes the yarn for your rug.
settings.image_alt: Cones of blue yarn lifted out of a dyeing vat

settings.title: You approve it
settings.text: We confirm your colours with you before production. A custom colour can add to the production time; we confirm the date with your order.
settings.image_alt: Cones of dyed yarn on a trolley in the yarn store

settings.label: Infinite Colours
settings.value: Any colour, matched to your reference. [colour_price] per colour, VAT included ([colour_price_net] without VAT).

settings.label: Lead time
settings.value: A custom colour can add to the production time. We confirm the date with your order.

settings.label: On screen
settings.value: The colours shown on a screen are indicative. A sample shows the real colour.

settings.label: Between batches
settings.value: Colour can vary slightly from one dye batch to the next. This is normal in any textile and is not a defect.
